title: The plan variant keeps an unreachable second dispatch arm and repeats its protocol literal across modules
outcome: The plan variant is dispatched twice and its advertised core operation key disagrees with the key storage actually uses
acceptance: Plans dispatch from exactly one site and the advertised core operation matches the key storage writes, or the divergence is documented at both sites

completion.summary:
Landed as 6c81fdd on origin/master and installed as build 3dc907d4.
- A plan is dispatched from one site: the opening match of work_propose_on, before ambient binding. propose_metadata and its dead Plan arm are gone, and the later match refuses a plan with InvalidWorkProjection instead of dispatching it.
- PLAN_PROTOCOL_OPERATION ("work_propose:plan") and PLAN_CORE_OPERATION ("propose_work_plan") replace the repeated literals. Their values, the plan_operation_key tuple and every stored row are unchanged.
- The divergence between the plan key and the generic core key is documented at both derivations.
- A new test derives the plan key independently, finds each receipt under it, and checks it is scoped to the session. A mutation check confirmed it fails when either value or the tuple order changes.
- Design reviewed first with Engram::Fable and a Codex explorer. The round-3 full gate passed on 1789bad plus this diff, and all three review rounds ended clean from Codex and Claude.
- Independent Codex evaluation: 1/1 criterion passes.
